title: Nemo boundaries profile (R05 first increment, candidate)
description: Input shape for scripts/nemo/lib/boundaries.cjs#checkProfile. Describes a BOUNDED set of modules under review, not the whole application — see README.md for the integration contract with the future R01/R03 inventory, which is expected to generate this shape rather than have it hand-authored long-term.

layerRules.description: Keyed by layer name (engineering/remediation/04_MODULARITY_POLICY.md's 'Logical layers'). A layer with no entry is treated permissively (no layer-violation is ever raised for imports it makes) — declare every layer you want enforced.

sizeProfiles.description: Keyed by the sizeProfile name modules reference. Real usage should copy the 'Initial size profiles' table from 04_MODULARITY_POLICY.md; tests may use smaller synthetic values.

id.description: Unique, stable module id, e.g. "domain.track". Used in violation reports and as the cycle-graph node.

layer.description: One of the logical layers from 04_MODULARITY_POLICY.md (domain, application, features, ports, adapters, bootstrap, shared) or a project-specific extension.

dir.description: Path to the module's directory, relative to the profile run's --root (normally the repo root).

files.description: Every file belonging to this module, relative to `dir`. Files not listed here are invisible to the checker even if they exist on disk (v1 does not walk the filesystem — see README limitations).

publicApi.description: Subset of `files` other modules may import. Reaching any file in `files` that is not also in `publicApi` from outside the module is a private-import violation.

sizeProfile.description: Key into the top-level `sizeProfiles` map. Applied per-file, not summed across the module.

allowedLayers.description: Layers this layer's modules may import from. "*" disables the check entirely for this layer (use for bootstrap, which composes everything).

path.description: Repo/root-relative file path, exactly as `dir`/file join produces it (posix separators).

ceiling.description: Only meaningful for rule "size": the raised hard maximum this exception grants. Exceeding the ceiling itself still fails.

owner.description: Accountable human owner, per 04_MODULARITY_POLICY.md's Exceptions section.

expires.description: ISO date. On/after this date the exception stops shielding its rule and is itself reported as an expired-exception violation.
